name: items_write

ops.description: Operations, one flat object each, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

title.description: Item title, max 500 chars. [ops: create, update]

type.description: Declared item type; required on create. [ops: create, update]

parentId.description: Parent id; omit for a root. Update moves the item. [ops: create, update]

summary.description: Short summary, max 2000 chars. [ops: create, update]

priority.description: Create defaults to medium. [ops: create, update]

tags.description: Lowercase, hyphenated. Update: [] clears. [ops: create, update]

traits.description: Declared traits, max 100 chars each. Update: [] clears. [ops: create, update]

properties.description: JSON object; no traits key. [ops: create, update]

id.description: Item UUID or 8+ hex prefix. [ops: update, delete]

expectedVersion.description: Fails version_conflict if the item is at another version. [ops: update, delete]

clear.description: Update only: optional fields to set to null. [ops: update]

recursive.description: Delete the subtree; required when the item has children. [ops: delete]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

description: Create, update and delete items, one ops[] element each. Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
